subject: Welcome — pick a 20-min walkthrough window or use the self-serve guide
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@edgescale.io>
Date: Sat, 28 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — pick a 20-min walkthrough window or use the self-serve guide

Hi Sam,

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood Inference — welcome! I wanted to share two quick paths so you can move fastest: 

1) Self-serve: our Quickstart PDF attached (redwood-quickstart.pdf) walks through the API keys, a minimal sample integration, and a checklist for production-ready settings.

2) 20-minute walkthrough: if you prefer a short pairing session to go over your use case (latency goals, model selection, deployment mode), book a 20-min slot here: https://cal.redwood.com/priyom/20min — I’ll be on the call and can bring an engineer if helpful.

If you have internal constraints (SAML-only signups, restricted IPs), reply here and we’ll loop in Monica from SDR ops to help schedule.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
(attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf)

From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@edgescale.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Apr 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome — pick a 20-min walkthrough window or use the self-serve guide

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the quick note.

I skimmed the quickstart, looks great. I’m based in PST but work with a team in IST; ideally we’d like a short session that accommodates both (late morning PST / late evening IST). Do you have any slots tomorrow that can hit ~11:00 AM PST? Otherwise I can send a few options.

Also, we’ll want a quick agenda focusing on throughput/latency and deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated).

—Sam
Sam Lewis
Platform Lead, EdgeScale
sam.lewis@edgescale.io

Hi Sam — Monica on SDR ops here, thanks for the note and context. I can cover your request for a slot that works for both PST and IST teammates.

I pulled a few options that tend to be convenient across the overlap windows:
• Mon, Apr 29 — 11:00 AM PT / 11:30 PM IST (20m)
• Tue, Apr 30 — 10:30 AM PT / 11:00 PM IST (20m)
• Wed, May 1 — 08:00 AM PT / 08:30 PM IST (20m)

Book any of the above directly: https://cal.redwood.com/monica/20min — I added a short agenda doc (attachment) that we’ll follow: 5m intros, 10m demo + model options, 5m next steps. If none of these work, reply with 2–3 times that do and I’ll manually sync the invite.

Notes: if EdgeScale prefers an internal-only meeting link (no Redwood calendar), let me know and we’ll send a calendar invite with your Zoom link.

Best,
Monica Patel
SDR Ops, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(attachment: agenda-20min.pdf)

Hi Monica — thanks for the options. The Mon, Apr 29 11:00 AM PT slot works for me and I’ll ask Arjun (Eng lead, IST) to hop on — he confirmed he can join at 11:30 PM IST. Please send an invite and Zoom link.

Two small asks for the meeting:

2) If we could call out likely throughput numbers for a 3-server dedicated pool vs hosted with aggressive batching, that’d be helpful for our budget discussion.

Thanks — Sam
